updates.sentence:
Documented in custody at Sandstone, Minnesota in both May–June and July–August 1968. Individual sentence length, actual time served and exact entry/release dates remain unverified.

An earlier list published in L’Adunata dei Refrattari, September30,1967, page5, reprinting The Peacemaker of September16,1967, individually names Michael Smith among federal prisoners at Sandstone alongside Barry Bondhus, Bob Gilliam and Glen VanOrnum. This documents custody earlier than the1968 rosters; the publication dates are not admission dates. Source: https://bibdig.biblioteca.unesp.br/server/api/core/bitstreams/3936d2a7-465d-4e0d-a19d-d88d3a029de9/content#page=5
